explanation: It opened in Japan in 1988 on a double bill with Isao Takahata's Grave of the Fireflies. Totoro later became the face of Studio Ghibli's logo.

claims.text: Hayao Miyazaki wrote and directed My Neighbour Totoro (1988).
Isao Takahata, Mamoru Hosoda and Satoshi Kon did not direct My Neighbour Totoro.
My Neighbour Totoro opened in Japan in 1988 on a double bill with Isao Takahata's Grave of the Fireflies.
Totoro appears in Studio Ghibli's logo.
